Security has been heightened around Jewish institutions, including synagogues, schools, and residential buildings, following escalating tensions in the Middle East involving Iran, Israel, and the United States. Authorities in Berlin have increased patrols and protective measures to prevent potential antisemitic attacks or unrest linked to the international crisis. Jewish organizations in Germany have repeatedly called for strong security protections as conflicts in the Middle East often trigger threats against Jewish communities in Europe.
